title: Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA station

terrainReference.basis: Fixed west-side diagonal boulevard approach before independent terrain acquisition. Platform/roof/footing levels are section estimates; no fitted/flattened ground.

note: Complete mapped station platforms and eight elevated track lanes with open viaducts and five folded canopies. Exact native platform/hall vertices; roof registration, sections, support census and ground contact are approximate. Adjacent arena/concert hall/plaza excluded.
